newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ACCC to hold Westpac -BML news conference.
newsitem.headline: ACCC to hold Westpac -BML news conference.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission said it would hold a news conference at midday (0200 GMT) on Friday to discuss its decision on the proposed takeover by Westpac Banking Corp of Bank of Melbourne Ltd.
The statement by the anti-monopolies body did not say what its long-awaited decision would be.

The Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Friday that the ACCC would approve the A$1.4 billion takeover with strict limitations on the merger that would retain the regional bank's identity in its home city of Melbourne.
Regulators had previously been opposed to the disappearance of all regional banks, which have large home loan exposures, from each state.
Westpac announced the A$1.44 billion agreed takeover on April 3 this year. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
